messages:
Samir: Hey team — quick Q: the /v1/documents endpoint sometimes returns `attachments: null` and sometimes `attachments: []` for docs with no attachments. Clients (JS SDK + some downstream services) are tripping schema validation. Which shape should we standardize on? Also: the ingestion worker emits streaming multipart/mixed chunks — does that change how we represent `no attachments` in streamed vs non-streamed responses? cc @Nina @Paul

Nina: We should pick one canonical shape. My vote is empty array (`[]`) for collections. Fewer null checks on client code and matches most REST conventions. For streaming, I'd prefer the stream include an explicit empty array part rather than a null token, but open to counterarguments. :thinking_face:

Paul: +1 on `[]`. For a safe rollout we can: (A) relax the JSON Schema/OpenAPI to accept `array | null` so older clients won't explode, (B) change server to always return `[]` for no attachments, (C) update SDK to coerce `null -> []` on parse, and (D) deprecate `null` in the changelog and remove support after 2 releases. Example schema change:
```
"attachments": {
  "type": ["array", "null"],
  "items": { "type": "object" }
}
```
This keeps compatibility while making the server the single source of truth for canonical shape.

Elena: I can take the server-side bit. I'll add a normalization step so empty attachments become `[]` and add unit/streaming tests. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/server/pull/3421 — will include a test that simulates the multipart stream and asserts the final aggregated payload has `attachments: []`.

Samir: Perfect. Also can someone update the JS SDK decode path? It's in `packages/sdk/src/response.ts` — currently it does `if (!Array.isArray(payload.attachments)) throw new Error(...)`. We should change that to `payload.attachments = payload.attachments || []` (and still validate item shapes). @Elena @Paul, can we gate the server PR and SDK tweak together so downstream apps keep working? Add a regression test in the SDK that accepts both `null` and `[]`.

Elena: I'll coordinate and tag @Paul on the SDK PR. I'll add a tiny migration note in the changelog and a test for the streaming worker case. ETA: EOD tomorrow to open the PRs.

deploy-bot: build #1287 queued for PR 3421 — status: running

Paul: One more operational note: add a quick Redwood Optimize eval that exercises attachments serialization with a sample workload, ensure we don't accidentally emit huge empty arrays or duplicate metadata in the stream assembly step. I'll add that to the rollout checklist.

Samir: Thanks everyone — TL;DR plan: 1) relax schema to allow `array|null`, 2) server change to normalize to `[]`, 3) SDK tolerant parsing + normalization, 4) deprecate `null` after 2 releases, 5) docs/openapi updated. @Nina can you update the OpenAPI examples and API changelog? :thumbsup:

Nina: On it — will update OpenAPI + add an example snippet showing `attachments: []` and note the deprecation timeline in the changelog.
